title: Gray background does not render "nice" on some phones
body:
**AndroidAPS 2.8.2.7-dev**

**Problem description:**
Gray-isch background does not render "nice" on some screens (depending on phone brand/type)

**Additional Info**
Please add option/theme for changing APPS main/overview background color to "black"?
(this would also save some battery power btw)

comments.body: I think you can switch to different theme, it might be better there.

I will work on my day/Night Branch Here in the Next few Weeks again.
And if @MilosKozak merge it into dev you have a Real Black background .

@osodebailar Sounds perfect!
I get the background can be set independently from day/Night (which is great also!)
Closing, as no longer relevant foor current UI
